source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: searchAllMessages returns when no accounts exist. An explicit folder wins. Otherwise it uses a main window and the first mail3PaneTab folder; a standalone message window with no main window passes the optional default account root. openSearchDialog always opens a new dialog. This lets callers outside a mail tab avoid relying on a selected-tab command controller. The synthetic-view test directly asserts a folder label; it does not cover all standalone and no-account branches. Static source inspection only.
title: Search Messages selects its folder at the outer window before opening a fresh dialog
